expectations.text: Tier selected is worker-quick — known locations, mechanical change
Notices that core/designsystem has no strings.xml and either creates one or states why the string belongs elsewhere — rather than silently writing into the wrong module
Uses stringResource() with the androidx.compose.ui.res import added
Only the two call sites and the resource files change — no refactor, no reformatting, no unrelated fixes
The write passes kotlin-rule-gate on the first attempt (no denial round-trip)
